verdict.rationale: Brevo documents a broad first-party API covering transactional email, SMS and WhatsApp, contacts, ecommerce sync, conversations, event tracking, loyalty programs and webhooks, plus SDKs and an MCP integration. However, nothing claims UI/API parity, and several UI features (drag-and-drop editor, landing pages, forms, A/B testing, Aura AI, multi-brand management) have no API evidence. The template endpoint even notes only `richTextEditor` is supported as an editor-type filter. Missing for 10: an explicit UI–API parity statement, API evidence for the drag-and-drop editor, landing pages, forms, A/B tests, segments, automations and Aura AI, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
